tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere. Warm cream, never pure white or grey.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the bottom nav and input fields sitting on `paper`.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells and quiet bands: the done band on the ladder, the crisis footer, unselected segment tracks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and resting card borders. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, unselected rating cells, toggles). 3.7:1 on `paper`, 3.9:1 on `paper-raised`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `paper`, `paper-raised`, `paper-sunk`, every tint, `apricot`, `marigold` and difficulty 0–7. 12.9:1 or better on the paper surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, meta lines, helper copy. On `paper` (5.6:1), `paper-raised` (5.9:1), `paper-sunk` (5.1:1), `apricot-tint` (5.0:1).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `difficulty-8`, `teal` and `ink` fills only.

tokens.name: apricot
tokens.usage: The warm primary. Primary button fill, the active nav pill, the log-a-rep button. Text on it is always `ink` (6.2:1), never white.

tokens.name: apricot-ink
tokens.usage: Apricot as text or icon: links, the 'x of y' number when a target is met, the wordmark's dot. 5.4:1 on `paper`, 4.9:1 on `apricot-tint`.

tokens.name: apricot-tint
tokens.usage: Warm wash behind a celebrated moment (a finished rung, a rep easier than predicted) and behind selected chips.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: The cool secondary. Focus ring, secondary text buttons, the 'predicted' reference line on charts, sessions accents. 5.4:1 on `paper`; `ink-inverse` on it for fills.

tokens.name: teal-tint
tokens.usage: Cool wash: the next-session card, info notes, the sync-status pill. `teal` text on it is 4.9:1.

tokens.name: marigold
tokens.usage: The flag. Fill of the 'bring to session' pennant when on, and the flagged-count badge. Always paired with an `ink` outline or `ink` text, never alone as meaning.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset in the surface colour. 5.4:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: difficulty-0
tokens.usage: Rating 0 of 8. Fill of the selected rating cell, rung marker and chart dot. `ink` text (12.4:1).

tokens.name: difficulty-1
tokens.usage: Rating 1 of 8. `ink` text (11.3:1).

tokens.name: difficulty-2
tokens.usage: Rating 2 of 8. `ink` text (10.0:1).

tokens.name: difficulty-3
tokens.usage: Rating 3 of 8, the last cool step. `ink` text (9.2:1). Under 4 means a rung is done.

tokens.name: difficulty-4
tokens.usage: Rating 4 of 8, the neutral sand midpoint. `ink` text (8.7:1).

tokens.name: difficulty-5
tokens.usage: Rating 5 of 8. `ink` text (7.5:1).

tokens.name: difficulty-6
tokens.usage: Rating 6 of 8. `ink` text (6.2:1).

tokens.name: difficulty-7
tokens.usage: Rating 7 of 8. `ink` text (4.6:1).

tokens.name: difficulty-8
tokens.usage: Rating 8 of 8: intense, not dangerous. `ink-inverse` text (5.3:1), the only step that flips.

styles.name: num-hero
styles.usage: The chosen 0–8 value, readable from arm's length. One per screen.

styles.name: num-lg
styles.usage: Predicted vs remaining in the task header; tally count.

styles.name: num-md
styles.usage: Rating cells, rung scores, target progress.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Sheet titles, task names in a detail header.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: You planned gym today. Log it when you're back.
styles.usage: Default reading text. 17px so it survives large dynamic type without breaking.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: Done. Rated it a 3, down from 6.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines, helper text, the crisis footer.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Worksheet column labels, uppercase. Keep the worksheet's own words.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tally mark spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; between rating cells.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside compact rows; label to value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the screen's side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Above a new screen section; around empty states.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target height is 44px; primary buttons and rating cells use 48px.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tally marks, small badges, checkbox corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rating cells, inputs, buttons, chips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, ladder rungs, sheets' inner blocks.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the bottom nav bar.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: the flagged count, sync status, nav active state.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards on `paper`. A paper-edge, not a float.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the bottom nav.
